hook: M G U, B Com Honours, Semester Six. Cost Accounting.
Tender or Quotations. Illustration seventeen, from Doctor Jayan's Cost Accounting Methods, page two seventy-six.
This time there is a twist. The overhead rates change next year.
Can you find the selling price before I do? Let's go.
question: Here is the question. The following figures have been obtained from the books of Samsung India Limited, for the year twenty twenty-five.
Direct material, six lakh rupees.
Direct wages, five lakh.
Factory overheads, three lakh.
Administration overheads, three lakh thirty-six thousand.
Selling overheads, two lakh twenty-four thousand.
Distribution overheads, one lakh forty thousand.
Profit, four lakh twenty thousand.
A new model has been introduced in twenty twenty-six. Material, eight thousand rupees. Wages, five thousand rupees.
In twenty twenty-six, the rate of factory overhead has increased by twenty percent,
the rate of distribution overhead has gone down by ten percent,
and selling and administration overhead rates have each gone up by twelve and a half percent.
At what price should the product be sold, so as to earn the same rate of profit on the selling price as in twenty twenty-five?
Factory overhead is based on direct wages, while all other overheads are based on factory cost.
Pause the video now, and try it yourself. Then check your answer with me.
step1: Step one. The cost sheet for the year twenty twenty-five.
Direct material, six lakh. Add direct wages, five lakh.
Works cost, or factory cost, fourteen lakh rupees.
Add administration overheads, three lakh thirty-six thousand.
Cost of production, seventeen lakh thirty-six thousand.
Add selling overheads, two lakh twenty-four thousand, and distribution overheads, one lakh forty thousand.
Cost of sales, twenty-one lakh rupees.
Add profit, four lakh twenty thousand.
Sales, twenty-five lakh twenty thousand rupees.
step2a: Step two A. The rates for twenty twenty-five.
Factory overhead, on direct wages. Three lakh into hundred, over five lakh. Sixty percent.
The other three overheads are on works cost, fourteen lakh.
Administration. Three lakh thirty-six thousand into hundred, over fourteen lakh. Twenty-four percent.
Selling. Two lakh twenty-four thousand into hundred, over fourteen lakh. Sixteen percent.
Distribution. One lakh forty thousand into hundred, over fourteen lakh. Ten percent.
Now the rate of profit. Four lakh twenty thousand into hundred, over twenty-five lakh twenty thousand, is sixteen point six six six seven percent on sales.
On cost: sixteen point six six six seven, over hundred minus sixteen point six six six seven, into hundred. That is twenty percent on cost.
step2b: Step two B. The revised rates for twenty twenty-six.
Factory overhead, increased by twenty percent. Sixty, into hundred and twenty over hundred. Seventy-two percent.
Careful! Not sixty plus twenty. The rate goes up by twenty percent of itself.
Administration, up twelve and a half percent. Twenty-four, into hundred and twelve point five over hundred. Twenty-seven percent.
Selling, also up twelve and a half percent. Sixteen, into hundred and twelve point five over hundred. Eighteen percent.
Distribution, down ten percent. Ten, into ninety over hundred. Nine percent.
step3: Step three. The estimated price of the new model, for twenty twenty-six.
Direct material, eight thousand. Add direct wages, five thousand.
Add factory overhead, seventy-two percent of wages. Five thousand into seventy-two, over hundred, is three thousand six hundred.
Works cost, or factory cost, sixteen thousand six hundred rupees.
Add administration overhead, twenty-seven percent of factory cost. Sixteen thousand six hundred into twenty-seven, over hundred, is four thousand four hundred and eighty-two.
Cost of production, twenty-one thousand and eighty-two rupees.
Add selling overhead, eighteen percent of factory cost. Two thousand nine hundred and eighty-eight.
Add distribution overhead, nine percent of factory cost. One thousand four hundred and ninety-four.
Cost of sales, twenty-five thousand five hundred and sixty-four rupees.

Add profit, twenty percent on cost. Twenty-five thousand five hundred and sixty-four into twenty, over hundred, is five thousand one hundred and twelve rupees, eighty paise. Rounded off, five thousand one hundred and thirteen.
Estimated selling price: thirty thousand six hundred and seventy-seven rupees.
tips: Three exam tips from this illustration.
Tip one. Check the base. Factory overhead goes on direct wages. Administration, selling and distribution all go on factory cost, not on cost of production.
Tip two. Increased by twenty percent does not mean add twenty. Multiply the old rate by hundred and twenty over hundred. So sixty becomes seventy-two, not eighty.
Tip three. Sixteen point six six six seven percent on sales is twenty percent on cost.
So profit is twenty percent of twenty-five thousand five hundred and sixty-four: five thousand one hundred and twelve rupees, eighty paise. Rounded off, five thousand one hundred and thirteen.
recap: Cost sheet for twenty twenty-five: factory cost fourteen lakh, sales twenty-five lakh twenty thousand.
Old rates: sixty, twenty-four, sixteen and ten percent. Profit, twenty percent on cost.
New rates: seventy-two, twenty-seven, eighteen and nine percent.
Selling price of the new model: thirty thousand six hundred and seventy-seven rupees.
